Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the disposition of unclaimed remains.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the disposition of unclaimed remains; andamending RCW 36.24.155.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.24.155 and 2009 c 549 s 4038 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Whenever anyone shall die within a county without making priorplans for the disposition of his or her body and there is no otherperson willing to provide for the disposition of the body, the countycoroner shall cause such body to be entrusted to a funeral home in thecounty where the body is found. Except in counties where the countycoroner or medical examiner has established a preferred funeral homeusing a qualified bidding process, disposition shall be on a rotationbasis, which shall treat equally all funeral homes or mortuariesdesiring to participate, such rotation to be established by the coronerafter consultation with representatives of the funeral homes ormortuaries in the county or counties involved.
